name: Data Scientist
responsibilities: Frame a vague business question as a data question and pick the right technique (mining, modeling, or plain description) to answer it
Clean and manipulate large structured and unstructured datasets, then build and compare models on real performance metrics, not just training loss
Turn analysis into a graph, dashboard, or oral and written presentation that management can act on
skills: Data-oriented programming and query languages (SQL, Python or R) plus business intelligence and data analysis software
Applying data mining, feature selection, and machine learning to extract signal from large datasets
Designing surveys or sampling methods when the data does not already exist
Explaining a model's results and limitations to a non-technical audience, in writing and out loud
rawSkillPool: Business intelligence and data analysis software
Database user interface and query software
Data mining and feature selection algorithms
Comparing models with statistical performance metrics
Written and oral presentation of findings

evidence.quote: Develop and implement a set of techniques or analytics applications to transform raw data into meaningful information using data-oriented programming languages and visualization software. Apply data mining, data modeling, natural language processing, and machine learning to extract and analyze information from large structured and unstructured datasets.
